Rekha Gupta
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Hyderabad
rekha.gupta223@example.com | +91 9727661471

Experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist with hands-on expertise in full-cycle recruitment, applicant tracking, and employer branding. Strong technical grounding from a computer engineering background enables effective hiring for technical roles and close collaboration with engineering teams. Focused on improving time-to-hire and candidate experience through data-driven sourcing and process optimization.

Experience
Dream11, Apr 2024 - Present
Talent Acquisition Specialist — Hybrid
- Managed end-to-end Talent Acquisition for product and engineering roles using Workday for requisition tracking, reducing time-to-fill by 18% through streamlined workflows and standardized interview templates.
- Sourced and engaged candidates across platforms, leveraging Recruitment best practices to build a pipeline of 120+ screened profiles in six months and convert 22 offers.
- Coordinated cross-functional interview schedules and debriefs, improving offer acceptance rate by 12% through timely feedback and compensation benchmarking.
- Ran weekly recruitment metrics reports in Workday to identify bottlenecks and implemented targeted outreach campaigns that increased diverse candidate responses by 25%.

Wipro, Nov 2023 - Mar 2024
Talent Acquisition Specialist — On-site
- Executed high-volume Recruitment for enterprise accounts, processing 200+ applications monthly and filling 35+ positions in the quarter using Workday for ATS management.
- Conducted structured interviews and assessment coordination, improving quality of hire scores by introducing calibrated interviewer rubrics.
- Built candidate pools through proactive sourcing and passive outreach, shortening average sourcing time by 20%.
- Partnered with hiring managers on role scoping and hiring plans, aligning hiring priorities with sprint cycles and Agile delivery timelines.

UrbanPantry, Sep 2022 - Oct 2023
HR Executive — On-site
- Drove Talent Acquisition efforts for operations and tech support roles, using LinkedIn Recruiter to source targeted talent; sourced and submitted 300+ candidates with a 15% conversion to interviews.
- Managed offer process and onboarding coordination, reducing new-hire administrative turnaround time by 30%.
- Implemented weekly candidate status tracking and feedback loops to improve candidate experience and reduce drop-off during interview stages.
- Collaborated with operations to forecast hiring needs aligned with business growth and supported Agile hiring sprints during peak seasons.

Projects
- Candidate Pipeline Automation: Implemented a simple Git-tracked intake tracker and standardized email templates to automate outreach cadence, increasing response rates by 22%.
- Interview Feedback Dashboard: Built a lightweight Linux-hosted dashboard to aggregate interviewer scores and feedback, enabling faster hiring decisions and clearer calibration.
